title: Why the Pentagon is asking for 'anomalies' as it plans for a long-term CR - Breaking Defense
html:
The Pentagon this week sent a list to Congress outlining almost two dozen defense programs for which the White House is seeking anomalies — or funding exemptions — if another continuing resolution (CR) is passed. The document notes that additional Defense Department anomaly requests are forthcoming.

In this episode of The Congressional Roundup, Director of Multimedia Daniel Woolfolk explains how an anomaly works and what programs the White House is prioritizing.
summary: The Trump administration is trying to protect Golden Dome and other priority programs as the budget remains uncertain.
